tools.name: plan_trip
tools.description: Plans a whole trip, home to home, within the total budget the traveller gives: flights, stays, transfers, activities, visas and daily costs. Use it when someone asks to plan or price a trip and has said where from, when, how many travellers and the total budget; the destination can be named or left

tools.name: get_trip
tools.description: Reads a trip planned earlier with plan_trip, by the trip id it returned: its status and, when ready, its options with every labelled price and the link to each option on trip720.travel. Use it when plan_trip answered 'building', or to show a planned trip again. Read only: it changes nothing. Trips a

tools.name: get_day_plan
tools.description: The day-by-day plan of one option of a trip planned with plan_trip: for each day the times, places and prices, and what to arrange before leaving. Use it when the traveller wants to see what each day looks like. Give the trip id, and optionId only for an option other than the recommended one. Read o

tools.name: find_trip_item_alternatives
tools.description: Lists the other choices for one priced line of a planned trip's option (a stay, a flight, a transfer or an activity), numbered, each with its price and what it does to the whole trip's Safe Trip Total and budget. Use it when the traveller wants a different hotel, flight, transfer or activity. The tr

tools.name: swap_trip_item
tools.description: Replaces one priced line of a planned trip's option with one of the numbered choices from find_trip_item_alternatives, and re-prices the whole option as the website does. Use it only after the traveller has picked one of those choices. Returns the updated option and its Safe Trip Total before and af

tools.name: get_destination_facts
tools.description: Trip720's researched facts for one destination, for travellers who live in Australia or the UK: what a day costs one person for food and local transport (street food, balanced, mostly restaurants), taxi prices, tourist tax, the most pleasant months, the visa for that home country, the sights not to

tools.name: check_entry_requirements
tools.description: Whether holiday travellers need a visa or an electronic travel authorisation, for each passport and each destination country: the rule's name, the minimum processing days and its source (official government pages where available). Use it for visa and entry questions. Read only. Holiday entry only, n

tools.name: get_best_time_to_visit
tools.description: When to go to a country, month by month: the best months overall, each covered place's most pleasant months with its monthly rain and daytime highs, and the busy holiday weeks to plan around. From climate averages (NASA POWER) and Trip720's research. Use it for questions about when to go. Read only.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "plan_trip" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
